name: Kikai no Gokan
source:
Main character awakens with amnesia in a room with machines and a man in a white coat. Another main in the neighboring room announces that this is his research institute for artificial intelligence. But current is totally different - it's about mounting human brain on an android and observing how it fares with controlling the machine. And protagonist is the first successful android with cloned human brain implanted.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在一个有机器和一个穿白大褂的男人的房间里因失忆而醒来。隔壁房间的另一位负责人宣布，这是他的人工智能研究所。但电流完全不同——它是将人脑安装在机器人上，并观察它如何控制机器。而主角是第一个成功植入克隆人大脑的机器人。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
